question: Which of the following is an example of an eastern coast port?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chennai Port**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Chennai Port** is one of the largest ports on the eastern coast of India.
 
• It is located on the Coromandel Coast of the Bay of Bengal.
 
• Chennai Port is the second largest container port in India, after Mumbai's Nhava Sheva.
 
• It handles a variety of cargo such as automobiles, petroleum products, coal, and containers, making it a critical port for trade and commerce.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mumbai Port**

 
 
• Mumbai Port is located on the western coast of India.
 
• It is one of the oldest and most significant ports of India, handling a large volume of cargo.
 
 
 
• **Mormugao Port**
 
 
• Mormugao Port is located in Goa, on the western coast of India.
 
• It is known for handling iron ore exports.
 
 
 
• **New Mangalore Port**
 
 
• New Mangalore Port is situated on the western coast of India in Karnataka.
 
• It primarily handles bulk cargo such as iron ore, coal, and crude oil.
